text:
Yafha...
Why is that?
I'm not blocking
your way just
to be a pain.
It's just...
The area around the ruins ahead
is a little dangerous.
Ruins?
What's left of a facility from
when this island was a testing ground.
Oh...
Ghosts of those killed in battle,
summoned creatures that went berserk
and became Strays...
Those sorts
gather there.
Even we Guardians
are forbidden by our rules
to go near it without permission.
I see...
I see...
There's no reason
to go sightseeing
in a place like that.
Go and finish
greeting everyone
in the settlements instead.
Yes, I will.
Then I will.
Now that all
our representatives
are gathered again, we need to talk.
It's about a problem
that's plagued the Silturn
and Maetropa settlements for some time.
The bandits who
began appearing a while ago.
Bandits?
More like
sneak thieves.
They come at night
and steal
our crops and such.
AND THEY APPEAR
TO BE HUMAN.
Human!?
Human!?
At first,
we suspected
you might be responsible.
But the timing doesn't fit.
They were appearing
before you arrived.
Naturally, they aren't
that Imperial Army group
we fought the other day either...
There are still other humans
on this island besides us...?
There are still other humans
on this island besides us...?
In any case,
we cannot
leave this unchecked.
We must locate them
and deal with them...
That's why we want
your cooperation.
We want you to help
us deal with the bandits.
That's why we want
your cooperation.
We want you to help
us deal with the bandits.
WE WOULD LIKE...
YOUR HELP...
Will you help us
deal with the bandits?
That's where
you lot come in.
